infiniteLogTableBlock.title: Infinite Log Table
infiniteLogTableBlock.description: A data- or schema-driven virtualized log explorer with dynamic columns and filters, seek pagination, live tailing, and record detail.
infiniteLogTableBlock.integrationBody: When records are provided, the block infers columns, field types, and filters from the data. Pass fields to explicitly control order, labels, visibility, filtering, sorting, and rendering. Pass dataSource for a cursor-backed API; remote sources should also provide fields. The block owns transient pagination and virtual rows while state and onStateChange control filters, sorting, and Live mode.
infiniteLogTableBlock.dataSourceBody: A data source returns opaque seek cursors bound to a snapshot revision. Live sources additionally provide a checkpoint, subscription, and metadata loader so result counts and facets stay current without replacing the history being examined.
infiniteLogTableBlock.registryBoundaryBody: The Registry artifact is plain React source: it does not import Next.js, React Query, nuqs, Zustand, SuperJSON, or Zod, and requires no provider. The monorepo-wide @zeron/blocks package currently retains a Next peer dependency for unrelated blocks; use the Registry artifact when a provider-free installation boundary is required.
